title: Neil deGrasse Tyson - We Stopped Dreaming (Episode 1)
summary: A short, music-driven video built from Neil deGrasse Tyson's remarks on why advancing the space frontier matters, contrasting NASA's small budget with war spending and stressing inspiration.
why: Recommended to anyone asking whether space exploration is worth the cost.
